tools.name: listAccounts
tools.title: List Accounts
tools.description: List all email accounts and their identities

tools.name: listFolders
tools.title: List Folders
tools.description: List all mail folders with URIs, message counts, and favorite status

accountId.description: Optional account ID (from listAccounts) to limit results to a single account

folderPath.description: Optional folder URI (from listFolders) to list only that folder and its subfolders

format.description: Response format: 'objects' (default, existing array of folder objects) or 'table' ({ columns, rows } compact form)

favoritesOnly.description: If true, return only folders the user has marked as favorites in Thunderbird (default: false). Useful for finding the folders that matter without listing hundreds.

savedSearches.description: If true, return only saved searches (virtual folders) with their folders and conditions

tools.name: searchMessages
tools.title: Search Mail
tools.description: Search message headers across accounts (Trash/Junk skipped). Returns { messages, totalMatches, offset, limit, hasMore }; each row has id + folderPath for getMessage/getMessages. For a company use query 'participant:@domain' with groupBy.

query.description: Words that must all match (subject, from, to, cc, preview). Operators: from:, to:, cc:, subject:, participant: (from/to/cc/bcc; '@domain' = addresses in that domain, commas = any of them: 'participant:@a.com,@b.com'); quote phrases, e.g. 'participant:@acme.com subject:"invoice 42"'. A single leading operator applies to all words ('from:Alice Smith'). Empty string matches all.

folderPath.description: Folder URI (from listFolders) to search, with subfolders

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date: on or before; date-only includes the whole day

offset.description: Rows to skip; use with hasMore

sortOrder.description: By date; default desc, asc with threadOf

groupBy.description: Collapse matches into one row per sender or conversation: count, unread, first/last date, latestId + latestFolderPath of the newest non-draft message, drafts count

threadOf.description: Return the whole conversation of this message across folders (incl. Sent), oldest first. A Re: message without threading headers joins by subject the earlier message its sender took part in (linkedBy: subject). Reads at most 10,000 headers; incomplete: true when it stopped there (narrow with folderPath)

format.description: 'table' returns messages as { columns, rows } (fewer tokens for long lists). 'legacy' (deprecated, to be removed in a later release): the 0.10 output, a plain array of full rows (threadId, folder, whole preview) unless offset is passed, 50 rows by default; not with groupBy

searchBody.description: Full-text search of subject, body and attachment names via the Gloda index (slower). Query: words or "quoted phrases", all must match, no operators; terms under 3 characters are ignored; English words match other forms (stemming), other languages such as Russian only the exact word form. IMAP needs offline sync.

dedupByMessageId.description: Collapse copies of one message in several folders into one row with dupLocations

tools.name: getMessage
tools.title: Get Message
tools.description: Read the full content of an email message by its ID

folderPath.description: The folder URI path (from searchMessages results)

saveAttachments.description: If true, save attachments to <OS temp dir>/commonpost-mcp/<messageId>/ and include filePath in response (default: false)

includeInlineImages.description: If true, append supported inline email images as MCP image content blocks after the text result (default: false; max 1 MiB base64 per image and 4 MiB total). Images referenced by the rendered body are attempted first in document order, followed by remaining inline images in MIME order. Ignored when rawSource is true.

bodyFormat.description: Body output format: 'markdown' (default, preserves structure), 'text' (plain text), 'html' (raw HTML)

rawSource.description: If true, return the full raw RFC 2822 message source (all headers + MIME parts). Useful for extracting calendar invites, S/MIME data, or debugging. Decoded as UTF-8 when valid, else by the charset of the top-level Content-Type, then of the parts, else a detected one; rawCharset names it, rawMixedCharsets lists the part charsets when they differ. Other fields (body, attachments) are omitted when this is set. Note: requires local/offline message copy; IMAP messages not cached offline may fail.

rawEncoding.description: With rawSource: 'base64' returns the exact bytes instead of decoded text, for 8bit/binary parts; pages then start and end on 4-character groups

maxBodyChars.description: Max characters of body (or rawSource) returned; longer bodies set bodyTruncated and nextBodyOffset

bodyOffset.description: Continue a truncated body from nextBodyOffset

tools.name: getMessages
tools.title: Get Messages
tools.description: Read full email content for up to 20 messages in one call. Each item needs messageId and folderPath from searchMessages/getRecentMessages results.

messages.description: Messages to read, max 20. Each item is { messageId, folderPath }.

folderPath.description: The folder URI path containing the message

saveAttachments.description: If true, save attachments for each message and include filePath in attachment metadata (default: false)

bodyFormat.description: Body output format shared by all messages: 'markdown' (default), 'text', or 'html'

rawSource.description: If true, return raw RFC 2822 source (decoded text, rawCharset) for each message instead of parsed body fields

rawEncoding.description: With rawSource: 'base64' returns the exact bytes instead of decoded text

maxBodyChars.description: Max body characters per message; read the rest with getMessage bodyOffset

tools.name: sendMail
tools.title: Compose Mail
tools.description: Compose a new email in a review window. The skipReview safety block is on by default; direct sending is honored only when the user explicitly disables that preference.

isHtml.description: Set to true if body contains HTML markup (default: false)

from.description: Sender identity (email address or identity ID from listAccounts)

skipReview.description: Request direct sending without a compose window. Honored only when the user explicitly disables the default-on skipReview safety block (default: false).

attachments.description: Attachments: file paths (strings) or inline objects ({name, contentType, base64})

content.description: Alias for base64 (accepted for backwards compatibility); base64 takes precedence when both are set

tools.name: saveDraft
tools.title: Save Draft
tools.description: Save a composed message to the identity's Drafts folder without sending or opening a compose window, as Thunderbird's compose window saves it; returns messageId + folderPath. Useful when a human will review and send the message later from Thunderbird. With draftId, rewrite that draft instead: passed fields replace, omitted ones (body, recipients, attachments, reply headers) are kept, and the old version is removed.

draftId.description: messageId of an existing draft to edit (from saveDraft, replyToMessage/forwardMessage mode draft, or a search in Drafts)

folderPath.description: Drafts folder URI of draftId; searched in all Drafts folders when omitted

keepAttachments.description: With draftId: keep the draft's attachments (new ones are added)

keepQuote.description: With draftId and body: replace only the typed text, keeping cite line, quote, forwarded message and signature

to.description: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated. Optional -- a draft can have no recipient.

isHtml.description: Set to true if body contains HTML markup (default: false). With draftId the draft keeps its format; isHtml changes it only when the whole body is replaced

from.description: Sender identity (email address or identity ID from listAccounts)

attachments.description: Attachments: file paths (strings) or inline objects ({name, contentType, base64})

content.description: Alias for base64 (accepted for backwards compatibility); base64 takes precedence when both are set

tools.name: listCalendars
tools.title: List Calendars
tools.description: List calendars: id, name, readOnly, disabled, supportsEvents, supportsTasks. The id is the calendarId of the event and task tools. A calendar with disabled: true is turned off in Thunderbird: it lists no events or tasks and createEvent/createTask refuse it until the user turns it on.

tools.name: createEvent
tools.title: Create Event
tools.description: Create a calendar event through a review dialog. The skipReview safety block is on by default; direct creation is honored only when the user explicitly disables that preference.

endDate.description: End date/time in ISO 8601 (defaults to startDate + 1h for timed, +1 day for all-day)

calendarId.description: Target calendar ID (from listCalendars, defaults to first writable calendar)

showAs.description: How the event appears in the calendar: 'busy' (solid block, TRANSP:OPAQUE + STATUS:CONFIRMED) or 'free' (hatched, TRANSP:TRANSPARENT + STATUS:TENTATIVE). Defaults to 'busy'. Overridden per-property by explicit status parameter.

categories.description: Category labels (optional). Category names are case-sensitive; use listCategories to get exact existing names before setting.

onlineMeeting.description: If true, generates a Microsoft Teams meeting link via Exchange (OWL/Office 365 accounts only). After creation, OWL embeds the join URL in the event description and exposes it via listEvents (onlineMeetingURL). No-op on non-OWL backends.

skipReview.description: Request direct creation without a review dialog. Honored only when the user explicitly disables the default-on skipReview safety block (default: false).

tools.name: listEvents
tools.title: List Events
tools.description: List calendar events within a date range

calendarId.description: Calendar ID to query (from listCalendars). If omitted, queries all calendars.

startDate.description: Start of date range in ISO 8601 format (default: now)

endDate.description: End of date range in ISO 8601 format (default: 30 days from startDate)

tools.name: updateEvent
tools.title: Update Event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event's title, dates, location, or description

calendarId.description: The calendar ID containing the event (from listEvents results)

startDate.description: New start date/time in ISO 8601 format (optional)

endDate.description: New end date/time in ISO 8601 format (optional)

showAs.description: How the event appears in the calendar: 'busy' (solid, TRANSP:OPAQUE + STATUS:CONFIRMED) or 'free' (hatched, TRANSP:TRANSPARENT + STATUS:TENTATIVE). Pass null to clear TRANSP only. Explicit status parameter overrides the STATUS coupling.

categories.description: Category labels (optional). Category names are case-sensitive; pass an empty array to clear all categories. Use listCategories to get exact existing names before setting.

onlineMeeting.description: If true, generates a Microsoft Teams meeting link via Exchange (OWL/Office 365 accounts only). Pass false to remove an existing Teams link.

tools.name: deleteEvent
tools.title: Delete Event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event by eventId + calendarId (from listEvents). For a recurring event the whole series is deleted.

calendarId.description: The calendar ID containing the event (from listEvents results)

tools.name: createTask
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Open a pre-filled task dialog for review. The skipReview safety block is on by default; direct saving is honored only when the user explicitly disables that preference.

calendarId.description: Target calendar ID (from listCalendars, must have supportsTasks=true)

categories.description: Category labels (optional). Use listCategories to get exact existing names before setting.

skipReview.description: Request direct saving without a review dialog. Honored only when the user explicitly disables the default-on skipReview safety block (default: false).

tools.name: listCategories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: Return all calendar category names defined in Thunderbird preferences. Use this before creating tasks or events to get exact category names (case-sensitive).

tools.name: listTasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List tasks/to-dos from Thunderbird calendars, optionally filtered by completion status or due date

calendarId.description: Calendar ID to query (from listCalendars). If omitted, queries all task-capable calendars.

completed.description: Filter by completion status. true = completed only, false = outstanding only. Omit for all tasks.

dueBefore.description: Return tasks due before this ISO 8601 date

tools.name: updateTask
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Update an existing task/to-do: change title, due date, description, priority, completion status, or percent complete

calendarId.description: Calendar ID containing the task (from listTasks results)

dueDate.description: New due date in ISO 8601 format (optional)

completed.description: Set to true to mark the task done (sets percentComplete=100 and records completedDate), false to reopen it (optional)

tools.name: searchContacts
tools.title: Search Contacts
tools.description: Search contacts in all address books by email, name or organization. Empty fields are omitted.

query.description: Words that must all match email, name or organization (e.g. 'acme' or '@acme.com')

maxResults.description: Max contacts; if cut, the response has hasMore: true

tools.name: getContact
tools.title: Get Contact
tools.description: Read one contact by id (from searchContacts): email, name, phones, addresses, organization, title, note, birthday

tools.name: createContact
tools.title: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a contact (default: first writable address book); at least one field must be set.

email.description: Primary email address. May be omitted for phone-only contacts.

phones.description: Phone numbers. On update, replaces the phone collection; use [] to clear it.

addresses.description: Postal addresses. On update, replaces the address collection; use [] to clear it.

note.description: Contact note; may contain multiple lines

birthday.description: Birthday as YYYY-MM-DD or --MM-DD when the year is unknown

addressBookId.description: Address book directory ID (from searchContacts results). Defaults to the first writable address book.

tools.name: updateContact
tools.title: Update Contact
tools.description: Update a contact by id: only passed fields change; phones and addresses replace the whole list

email.description: Primary email address. May be omitted for phone-only contacts.

phones.description: Phone numbers. On update, replaces the phone collection; use [] to clear it.

addresses.description: Postal addresses. On update, replaces the address collection; use [] to clear it.

note.description: Contact note; may contain multiple lines

birthday.description: Birthday as YYYY-MM-DD or --MM-DD when the year is unknown

tools.name: deleteContact
tools.title: Delete Contact
tools.description: Delete a contact from its address book

tools.name: replyToMessage
tools.title: Reply to Message
tools.description: Reply with quoted original text. mode: window (compose window for review, default), draft (save to Drafts with the recipients Thunderbird computes: Reply-To, Mail-Followup-To, mailing lists, identity auto Cc/Bcc; returns messageId + folderPath; needs the saveDraft tool enabled), send (direct, needs to and from; blocked unless the user disables the skipReview safety block).

messageId.description: The message ID to reply to (from searchMessages results)

folderPath.description: The folder URI path (from searchMessages results)

latestInThread.description: Reply to the newest message of this conversation instead (Sent included); not with mode send. Result: repliedTo when another message was answered, threadIncomplete when the mailbox was read in part and a newer message may exist

isHtml.description: Set to true if body contains HTML markup (default: false)

to.description: Override the recipients Thunderbird computes (required with mode send)

from.description: Sender identity (email address or identity ID from listAccounts); default: the identity the message was addressed to, as in Thunderbird. Required with mode send.

skipReview.description: Legacy: true means mode send (default: false)

attachments.description: Attachments: file paths (strings) or inline objects ({name, contentType, base64})

content.description: Alias for base64 (accepted for backwards compatibility); base64 takes precedence when both are set

tools.name: forwardMessage
tools.title: Forward Message
tools.description: Forward with the original content and attachments. mode: window (compose window for review, default), draft (save to Drafts, to optional; returns messageId + folderPath; needs the saveDraft tool enabled), send (direct, needs to and from; blocked unless the user disables the skipReview safety block).

messageId.description: The message ID to forward (from searchMessages results)

folderPath.description: The folder URI path (from searchMessages results)

to.description: Recipient email address (required with mode send)

isHtml.description: Set to true if body contains HTML markup (default: false)

from.description: Sender identity (email address or identity ID from listAccounts); default: the identity the message was addressed to, as in Thunderbird. Required with mode send.

skipReview.description: Legacy: true means mode send (default: false)

attachments.description: Additional attachments: file paths (strings) or inline objects ({name, contentType, base64})

content.description: Alias for base64 (accepted for backwards compatibility); base64 takes precedence when both are set

tools.name: getRecentMessages
tools.title: Get Recent Messages
tools.description: Recent messages newest-first from all folders of all accounts (Trash/Junk skipped) or from one folder. Same envelope and row format as searchMessages.

folderPath.description: Folder URI (from listFolders); omit for all folders

daysBack.description: Only messages from the last N days

offset.description: Rows to skip; use with hasMore

format.description: 'table' returns messages as { columns, rows }. 'legacy' (deprecated): the 0.10 output, as in searchMessages

tools.name: displayMessage
tools.title: Display Message
tools.description: Open or navigate to a message in the Thunderbird GUI. Use '3pane' (default) to select the message in the mail view, 'tab' to open in a new tab, or 'window' to open in a standalone window.

folderPath.description: The folder URI path (from searchMessages results)

displayMode.description: How to display: '3pane' (navigate in mail view, default), 'tab' (new tab), or 'window' (new window)

tools.name: deleteMessages
tools.title: Delete Messages
tools.description: Delete messages from a folder. Drafts are moved to Trash instead of permanently deleted.

messageIds.description: Array of message IDs to delete

folderPath.description: The folder URI containing the messages (from listFolders or searchMessages results)

tools.name: updateMessage
tools.title: Update Message
tools.description: Update one or more messages' read/flagged/tagged state and optionally move them. Supply messageId for a single message or messageIds for bulk operations. Tags are Thunderbird keywords (e.g. '$label1' for Important, '$label2' for Work, or any custom string). Note: combining tags with moveTo/trash on IMAP may not preserve tags on the moved copy — use separate calls if needed.

messageId.description: A single message ID (from searchMessages results). Required unless messageIds is provided.

messageIds.description: Array of message IDs for bulk operations. Required unless messageId is provided.

folderPath.description: The folder URI containing the message(s) (from searchMessages results)

read.description: Set to true/false to mark read/unread (optional)

addTags.description: Tag keywords to add (e.g. ['$label1', 'project-x']). Thunderbird built-in tags: $label1 (Important), $label2 (Work), $label3 (Personal), $label4 (To Do), $label5 (Later)

removeTags.description: Tag keywords to remove from the message(s)

moveTo.description: Destination folder URI (optional). Cannot be used with trash.

trash.description: Set to true to move message to Trash (optional). Cannot be used with moveTo.

tools.name: createFolder
tools.title: Create Folder
tools.description: Create a new mail subfolder under an existing folder. Note: on IMAP accounts, server-side completion is asynchronous; verify with listFolders.

parentFolderPath.description: URI of the parent folder (from listFolders)

savedSearch.description: Create a saved search (live view, nothing moved) instead of a subfolder

tools.name: renameFolder
tools.title: Rename Folder
tools.description: Rename an existing mail folder. Note: on IMAP accounts, server-side completion is asynchronous; verify with listFolders.

folderPath.description: URI of the folder to rename (from listFolders)

tools.name: deleteFolder
tools.title: Delete Folder
tools.description: Delete a mail folder and all its contents; a saved search is only a view (no mail deleted). Moves to Trash, or permanently deletes if already in Trash. Note: permanent deletion may prompt the user for confirmation. On IMAP accounts, server-side completion is asynchronous; verify with listFolders.

folderPath.description: URI of the folder to delete (from listFolders)

tools.name: emptyTrash
tools.title: Empty Trash
tools.description: Permanently delete all messages in the Trash folder for an account.

accountId.description: Account ID (from listAccounts). If omitted, empties Trash for all accessible accounts.

tools.name: emptyJunk
tools.title: Empty Junk
tools.description: Permanently delete all messages in the Junk/Spam folder for an account.

accountId.description: Account ID (from listAccounts). If omitted, empties Junk for all accessible accounts.

tools.name: moveFolder
tools.title: Move Folder
tools.description: Move a mail folder to a new parent folder within the same account. Note: on IMAP accounts, server-side completion is asynchronous; verify with listFolders.

folderPath.description: URI of the folder to move (from listFolders)

newParentPath.description: URI of the destination parent folder (from listFolders)

tools.name: listFilters
tools.title: List Filters
tools.description: List all mail filters/rules for an account with their conditions and actions. With confirmation: true it instead reads, without changing anything, the state of a filter change waiting for, or settled by, the user's confirmation in Thunderbird: pending, accepted (written), refused (by the user, or the dialog was closed), expired (no answer within the time limit, 10 minutes) or failed (accepted, but the filter list, account or setting changed meanwhile: nothing written). Without confirmationId the result is the pending request (at most one) and the recent ones, with the limits (one pending, five dialogs per hour); with the confirmationId returned with status pending_user_confirmation, the state of that request. accountId is ignored, and confirmationId is ignored unless confirmation is true. MCP clients cannot accept, refuse or cancel a confirmation.

accountId.description: Account ID from listAccounts (omit for all accounts). Ignored when confirmation is true.

confirmation.description: When true, return the state of the pending and recent filter confirmations instead of the filters (optional, default false)

confirmationId.description: With confirmation: true, the confirmationId returned with status pending_user_confirmation, to read that one request (optional; ignored unless confirmation is true)

tools.name: createFilter
tools.title: Create Filter
tools.description: Create a new mail filter rule on an account. A rule that forwards or replies (sends mail), or a new rule in a filter list that already holds a rule sending mail, is refused by default ("Filter rules that send mail: Always block"); only if the user has switched the setting to "Ask me each time" does the call instead return {status: "pending_user_confirmation", confirmationId} and let Thunderbird ask the user in a dialog (only the user can accept; follow it with listFilters, confirmation: true and the confirmationId). Forward takes exactly one plain e-mail address; reply takes a template of a Templates folder (<folder URI>?messageId=<id>&subject=<subject>). Sending rules for outgoing mail (type 64) are always refused.

attrib.description: Attribute -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgSearchAttrib/nsMsgSearchOp

op.description: Operator -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgSearchAttrib/nsMsgSearchOp

header.description: Not used by any available attribute

type.description: Action -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgFilterAction

insertAtIndex.description: Position to insert (0 = top priority, default: end of list)

tools.name: updateFilter
tools.title: Update Filter
tools.description: Modify an existing filter's properties, conditions, or actions. Adding forward/reply actions, or changing a filter list that holds a rule sending mail (including enabling or editing that rule), is refused by default ("Always block"); it instead needs the user's confirmation in Thunderbird (the call returns {status: "pending_user_confirmation", confirmationId}; follow it with listFilters, confirmation: true and the confirmationId) only if the user has switched the setting to "Ask me each time". Sending rules for outgoing mail (type 64) are always refused.

conditions.description: Replace all conditions (optional, same format as createFilter)

attrib.description: Attribute -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgSearchAttrib/nsMsgSearchOp

op.description: Operator -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgSearchAttrib/nsMsgSearchOp

header.description: Not used by any available attribute

actions.description: Replace all actions (optional, same format as createFilter)

type.description: Action -- unavailable: this Thunderbird did not expose nsMsgFilterAction

tools.name: deleteFilter
tools.title: Delete Filter
tools.description: Delete a mail filter by index (from listFilters). Later filters shift up by one. Deleting a rule that sends mail is always allowed; deleting another rule of a list that holds one is refused by default ("Always block"), or needs the user's confirmation if the user has switched the setting to "Ask me each time".

tools.name: reorderFilters
tools.title: Reorder Filters
tools.description: Move a filter to a different position in the execution order. In a filter list that holds a rule sending mail, this is refused by default ("Always block"); it needs the user's confirmation (returns status pending_user_confirmation) only if the user has switched the setting to "Ask me each time".

tools.name: applyFilters
tools.title: Apply Filters
tools.description: Manually run filters on a folder to organize existing messages. Only rules that are enabled and marked "Manually Run" are run; the others, and rules that move or copy to a folder of an account that is not authorized or to the Outbox, are skipped and listed under `skipped` with the reason. If the account's filter list holds a rule that forwards, replies or runs an add-on action, running it is refused by default ("Always block"); it needs the user's confirmation in Thunderbird (returns status pending_user_confirmation; follow it with listFilters, confirmation: true and the confirmationId) only if the user has switched the setting to "Ask me each time".

folderPath.description: Folder URI to apply filters to (from listFolders)

tools.name: getAccountAccess
tools.title: Get Account Access
tools.description: Get the current account access control list. Shows which accounts the MCP server can access. Account access is configured by the user in the extension settings page (Tools > Add-ons > Commonpost MCP for Thunderbird > Options) and cannot be changed via MCP tools.
